modifications: package renamed roce -> roce_ring: OpMeta name, the two CuTe kernel ids (comm.roce_ring.oneshot / .allgather), the default proxy cache subdirectory (b12x/roce_ring) and two messages, so a shared B12X_COMPILE_CACHE_DIR never hands one package the other's compiled kernels (proxy builds are keyed by source hash)
_path_config.py: B12X_ROCE_PEER_HCA_MAPS (four ';'-separated peer maps selected by rank) so one launcher env line serves every rank; B12X_ROCE_PEER_HCA_MAP still wins when set
_roce_proxy.c: ROCE_IDLE_SPINS 200000 -> 20000000 (the value of the SG17 proxy in runtime/b12x); at 200000 the proxy napped between the decode step's collectives
source_note: sparkring keeps two copies of this package; this is the frozen release copy (bundle-source, last changed 2026-09-06), which is what was measured. The maintained third_party/b12x_roce copy has three later fixes not included here: timeout detection across sequence wrap (f91b5c8), atomic proxy counters (2d83bb6), memory-scope and polling fixes (e4d0921).
